name: VaultVisionTV
description: VaultVisionTV turns a library of classic TV and movies streamed from the Internet Archive into always-on broadcast channels with deterministic, wall-clock-driven scheduling. Integrates as a Jellyfin Live TV source (M3U tuner + XMLTV guide) so it works on every Jellyfin client.
overview: Simulated 90s cable channels streamed from archive.org, as Jellyfin Live TV

versions.changelog: Log the actual reason a stream request fails (no schedule position, broken episode, commercial-break gap, archive.org resolve failure) instead of collapsing everything into an unexplained 503.
Initial Phase 1: channel lineup, deterministic scheduler, catalog fetch/cache, M3U + XMLTV endpoints, live tune-in via ffmpeg. No seamless slot chaining or commercial-break padding yet.
